claims.statement: No proper favorable-leaf selector occurs among the 308 eligible tree-rank pairs in the two searched families; the 1,540 KL triples in the stated box have no eligible ranks.
claims.scope: Exact search of KL T(k1,k2,k3) with 1<=k1<=k2<=k3<=20, central path spiders with 3..5 arms of lengths 1..8, and the five named KL fixtures with a path of length 1..5 grafted at each nonleaf vertex; only integer ranks x+2<=p and 3p<2alpha+1 are included.
claims.reason: Exact forest-DP coefficients and exhaustive leaf-selector evaluation on these finite generated families found zero mixed favorable/nonfavorable selectors. The finite bounds do not establish a universal selector property; the eligible control example has all leaves favorable and S=-2745.

limitations: This is a finite family search, not a census of ordinary trees; it leaves the requested proper-selector witness unresolved.
No primary theorem is imported and no conclusion is drawn about trees outside the listed recipes and parameter ranges.
